svg.title: Clusternet service-based architecture
svg.desc: Four coarse-grained independently deployable service binaries: clusternet-hub and clusternet-scheduler and clusternet-controller-manager in the parent cluster, clusternet-agent in each child cluster, communicating via Kubernetes API server watch/informer and CRD objects.

g.text: Watch / informer · CRD objects · no direct RPC

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does clusternet-hub manage in the parent cluster?')
sendPrompt('How does clusternet-hub handle cluster registration?')
sendPrompt('What tunnel and Shadow API does clusternet-hub manage?')
sendPrompt('How does clusternet-scheduler place workloads across clusters?')
sendPrompt('How does clusternet-scheduler bind workloads to clusters?')
sendPrompt('What lifecycle management does clusternet-controller-manager handle?')

svg.text: CRDs: ManagedCluster · Subscription · Localization · Globalization · Base · Description
hub tunnel · watch / informer · CRD sync
Child clusters — one clusternet-agent per cluster

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does clusternet-agent do in child clusters?')
g.text: cmd/ · pkg/ · deploy/ — independently deployed in each child cluster

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does clusternet-agent register a cluster?')
sendPrompt('How does clusternet-agent report status back to the parent cluster?')
sendPrompt('How does clusternet-agent interact with the child cluster API server?')

svg.text: Each binary: own cmd/ · pkg/ · deploy/ YAML — independently versioned and deployed
